title: Grammy nominations and Ella always winning
summary: She was nominated by NARAS in 1980 for 'Sneakin' Around' and again in 1981 for the Muse album. She figures Ella will always win but is happy to be considered.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Being honored: NEA Jazz Masters and other awards
